summary.text: Mike Soboleski is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 73 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A business owner and U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he is listed on Ballotpedia as Michael Soboleski.

paragraphs.text: Michael "Mike" Soboleski was born in Maine and graduated from Gardiner Area High School.
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps and earned a degree from the University of Maine at Machias.

His career experience includes founding, and later selling, a fitness equipment sales and servicing company, working as an actor, and running field operations in Maine for the 2020 Census for the U.S. Census Bureau.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the Franklin County Republican Committee, the American Legion, the National Rifle Association, Gun Owners of Maine, and Americans for Tax Reform.
Soboleski assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 6, 2022, succeeding John Andrews.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Environment and Natural Resources Committee and the Labor and Housing Committee.
